description:
Step of fz-t93: the engine (crates/fz-engine) owns the interner for its own keys; the World is not involved. Spike (develop 01e69178a, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/dist/ids2/report.md, diff spike_engine_ids_full.diff): Scheduler mints RunId/PublisherId on first crossing; agenda, rebased, read_finality, pending_reason, FactTable publisher sets and DependencyIndex indexed by id: distiller instructions -7.4%, distinct1 -6.9%, Derivation hashes 2.25M -> 60k, dumps identical, all gates green. After fz-t93.7 one interner covers what are today DependencyKey (4.27M hashes) and ProductKey (2.79M), the hottest remaining. Open: pop clones the Job out of the interner per run start (driver needs an owned Job while holding &mut World); carry the id through the driver instead.

Original finding:
Needs a proposal page before any build. Finding (OptionParser session, measured on one OptionParser.parse compile, release, 30 sampled runs; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/why/attrib.txt): 26-44% of samples in SipHash and 21-32% in malloc/free; by phase, product pull machinery 29%, job completion bookkeeping 20%, analyze_activation 20%, scheduler dispatch 8%, interning 6%. Census: 2.2M hash calls into about 500k tables for 2,550 jobs. Ranking (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/hash/step1_distinct1_ranking.txt): FactSlot table 9.8%, ProductMemo.produced 4.2%, deps subscribers 3.1%, product_readers 2.3%, pending_dependencies 2.0%, read_finality 1.8%, rooted 1.6%. These tables are keyed by large structural values (FactKey, product addresses). Epic fz-53f removes temporaries, copies and per-body tables and swaps the hasher last (fz-53f.7) but does not change what these tables are keyed by. Idea to prove with a spike: intern each key kind once (World owns interning) and make the tables per-kind vectors indexed by the id, so a lookup is an index and a key is hashed once at interning. The proposal states what goes away (structural hashing on every read, the hash tables themselves) and measures hash calls and instructions before/after on OptionParser.parse and the distiller. Order: after fz-53f.5/.6 (type interner and activation symbol identity), which settle the ids this would index by.

Also indexed by id: the engine's cycle groups (crates/fz-engine/src/groups.rs, Groups.of / groups / open). fz-afu.15 landed at a measured +0.40% distiller instructions (+63.6M; 132,738 group-membership lookups at about 500 instructions each, almost all hashing the Job; scratchpad afu15b/report.md 'Cost chase'), accepted by the user on the condition that this step recovers it. Acceptance adds: group membership is an id-indexed column, and the group lookups' cost is measured as recovered.
